verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents agent workflows for discovering sellers and creating/charging kya, pay, and kya-pay tokens (via API or MCP tools like create-pay-token) that authorize a purchase, and there's a 'Building an Agentic Checkout' page using its Payments React SDK — but none of this evidence documents a protocol call to create or update a cart/order draft object (e.g., adding/removing line items, quantities, or draft state) as opposed to authorizing/settling a payment. Missing for 10: explicit cart/order-draft creation or update API/tool, line-item or quantity manipulation, and any draft-state representation prior to token/payment issuance.
